info.description: Every HTTP route of the Pennywise backend services, generated from the route registrations and handler request types. See docs/api/README.md.

item.name: Pennywise API
item.description: Core REST API (go-pennywise-api, port 5151). Authenticated routes send `X-API-Key: {{apiKey}}`, and `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` as the fallback when apiKey is empty. Log in with *auth / POST /auth/demo* (DEMO_MODE) or *POST /auth/google*, then run *keys / POST /keys* to save a key. Keys are read-only, so routes needing another scope have the X-API-Key header off. Budget-scoped routes send `X-Budget-ID: {{budgetId}}`; *GET /budgets* saves the first budget's id.

header.description: Leave apiKey empty to use the bearer token instead.

request.description: Handler: `websocketHandler.Connect` in `backend/go-pennywise-api/internal/handler/websocket.go`. API keys need scope **read**. WebSocket upgrade. Connect with a WebSocket client to `ws://localhost:5151/ws?token={{accessToken}}&budgetId={{budgetId}}`; a plain GET only shows the upgrade error.
